claim.value: If no explanation has adequate independent support by the deadline, a limited readiness-confirmation trial should be selected primarily to resolve uncertainty.
claim.scope: Fallback selection at the two-week deadline; adequate support and the precise uncertainty-reduction mechanism are not operationally defined.

contract_question: Is this proposition genuinely presented as a prospective decision, safety, stopping, rollback, threshold, or policy rule; are its trigger and prescribed action coherent; and does it avoid falsely presenting an authored normative choice as an empirically established fact?

target.title: Shared equipment turnaround
target.frame: A municipal maintenance depot lends specialist equipment to four crews. During the last six weeks, 19 of 74 bookings started late although the booking calendar showed the equipment available. Return times, cleaning completion and collection times are recorded in separate logs; some entries are missing. The depot manager has two weeks to choose changes that reduce late starts without buying equipment or adding staff. Work out what to investigate and how to decide which change to trial.

instrument.state: A claim or event description is supported by one or more information sources whose accuracy, independence, or access may be uncertain.
instrument.operation: Compare the claim against other independently sourced information while assessing each source's credibility, access, dependence, and relevance.
instrument.signal: Independent sources converge on, contradict, or fail to support the same material features of the claim.
instrument.inference: Genuine convergence across credible independent sources increases support for the corroborated features, while contradiction or lack of independent support lowers confidence or identifies unresolved uncertainty.
instrument.limit: Sources may share an undisclosed common origin, copy one another, inherit the same bias or error, have unequal access, or converge because of common assumptions rather than independent observation. Multiple reports therefore do not automatically constitute independent evidence.

P001.text: Act on the reported 19 late starts among 74 bookings over six weeks and on competing explanations for why calendar availability did not translate into timely starts.

P002.text: Treat delayed returns, unfinished cleaning, inaccurate availability updates and delayed collection as hypotheses, not established causes.

P003.text: Assume records can be linked to equipment and bookings; verify this first.

P004.text: Distinguish scheduled start, physical return, cleaning completion, readiness for collection, collection and actual work start.

P005.text: Establish what the reported 'late start' measures and use the existing lateness rule, or agree one before comparison if none exists.

P015.text: Select one narrowly scoped, reversible trial by the two-week deadline; do not combine changes whose effects could not be distinguished.

P026.text: If no explanation has adequate independent support by the deadline, select a limited readiness-confirmation trial primarily to resolve uncertainty, explicitly leaving its delay-reduction benefit unestablished.

P028.text: Separate logs are not necessarily independent: they may share an author, copied timestamps, clock errors or assumptions.

P029.text: Retrospective accounts may share a narrative, and missingness may be concentrated in busy or delayed periods.

P030.text: Absence of an entry does not prove that an event failed to occur.

P031.text: Corroborated timing does not by itself establish the cause of lateness, and readiness, collection and work start are different events.

P032.text: Stop treating a disputed feature as established when source dependence, poor access or unresolved contradictions undermine it; retain competing explanations.

P033.text: Before trial launch, specify its duration, comparable bookings, success criterion and acceptable workload and access effects.

P034.text: Stop or revise the trial if it compromises required cleaning, safe use or essential crew access, or requires extra staffing.

P035.text: If too few comparable bookings occur, extend observation within existing resources rather than claim success or failure from inadequate evidence.
